title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Strawberry Banana 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Strawberry Banana blends the soft, juicy sweetness of ripe Strawberries with the smooth, creamy notes of Banana for a rich and well-rounded vape. This classic fruit combination delivers a authentically sweet and mellow inhale, followed by a satisfying, velvety exhale. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid ensures a consistently smooth throat hit with optimised nicotine absorption. The 50/50 VG/PG ratio enhances flavour clarity while keeping vapour production discreet, making it an excellent match for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids provide a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, offering familiar and satisfying flavours in a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle features a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for convenience.
